title: Bug: run_shell_command hangs for 5 mins on interactive/slow commands (! Shell awaiting input)

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a detailed and actionable report regarding run_shell_command hanging on interactive PTY inputs or slow execution due to a hardcoded 5-minute timeout, along with concrete expected behaviors.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing this issue requires updating configuration schema across packages/cli and packages/core, modifying shell timeout behavior, and adjusting PTY vs fallback execution handling in shell execution services.

summary.problem: When run_shell_command executes an interactive or slow process, the CLI spawns a PTY waiting for input and blocks the AI agent until a 5-minute timeout occurs.
summary.root_cause: The default inactivity timeout is set to 5 minutes (300 seconds) and PTY execution runs by default without a setting to disable PTY for agent execution or easily adjust the shell command timeout.
summary.context: AI agents cannot interactively respond to PTY prompts. Allowing users to configure shell command timeouts and disable PTY execution for agent sessions prevents agents from hanging.

steps: Add settings configuration options in settingsSchema.ts for shell tool inactivity timeout and PTY execution preferences for agent workflows.
Update CLI config loader in packages/cli/src/config/config.ts to read the shell settings and pass them to core Config.
Update Config class in packages/core/src/config/config.ts to store and expose the shell PTY and inactivity timeout configurations.
Update Shell execution logic in packages/core/src/tools/shell.ts to respect configured inactivity timeouts and non-interactive PTY execution mode.
Update ShellExecutionService in packages/core/src/services/shellExecutionService.ts to skip node-pty execution when non-interactive or PTY disabled for agents.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Shell commands enforce configured inactivity timeouts and non-interactive execution without hanging on interactive PTY input.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in shell.test.ts verifying custom shell inactivity timeout triggers abort.
Add unit tests verifying non-interactive mode bypasses PTY execution.
